text.description_html:
NGP 5050, Silicone Bulb Fire and Smoke Seal

Features and Specifications of the Self-Adhesive Silicone Gasketing Silicone Bulb Fire and Smoke Seal:

  • Length: 20 feet
  • Height: 1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Material: Silicone
  • Smoke and Draft Control - Category “H”:
    • Up to 3 hours Hollow Metal fire doors
    • Up to 90 minutes Wood fire doors
  • Meets requirements of RoHS Directive

Special Ordered Item. No Returns.
